note: package-lock.json / packages/*/package.json version drift measured when scripts/check-lock-workspace-versions.mjs landed. Each entry waives ONE package's stale lock entry, pinned to the EXACT lock/manifest version pair observed. This file is a RATCHET, not an exemption: the gate refuses to let the set grow (an unwaived mismatch still fails), and an entry whose pinned pair no longer matches current drift -- because the lock was regenerated, or the manifest moved again without the lock following it -- is itself a finding, so fixing the drift and deleting its entry are the same commit. Every run prints the waived set: a waived run is not a clean one. Several consolidation batches were in flight regenerating the lock when this file was written, so it may already be smaller than this by the time anyone reads it -- the gate, not this note, is the current source of truth. When this file is empty, delete it and close #917.
